title: Efficacy of Intravitreal Dexamethasone Implant (Ozurdex®) in Naïve and Refractory Patients with Different Morphological Subtypes of Diabetic Macular Edema

The Methods describe mixed-effects models with maximum-likelihood handling of missing data for inference; Table 2 presents observed mean (SD) values.

Ambiguity resolved: Table 2 tabulates two crossing baseline partitions (morphology and treatment status); the treatment-status partition is extracted because prior treatment is a per-series protocol field, and the morphology columns are excluded to avoid counting eyes twice.

Ambiguity resolved: CST is named 'central subfoveal thickness' and is generated by the device software; the edema and retreatment criteria refer to thickness in the central subfield, so it is recorded as central_subfield.

Ambiguity resolved: the 6-month analysis follows one implant per eye (abstract: all subjects received a single injection); additional implants given during the longer overall follow-up are not part of the analysed window, so regimen is single.
